quote_zh: 在装有搅拌器,温度计和回流冷凝管的500ml四口反应瓶中加入2-氯甲苯25.3g(0.2mol)、无水三氯化铝40.5g(0.3mol)和1,2-二氯乙烷150ml,冷却至5℃,然后滴加甲磺酰氯25.25g(0.22mol),滴加温度不超过10℃,滴加完毕,升至室温继续反应10h,LC跟踪（液相色谱）至反应完全,...,浓缩得淡黄的固体28.6g,收率84％。
arithmetic_check: Charges: 2-chlorotoluene 25.3 g / 0.2 mol implies MW 126.5 against C7H7Cl = 126.59, correct; methanesulfonyl chloride 25.25 g / 0.22 mol implies 114.77 against CH3ClO2S = 114.55, correct; aluminium trichloride 40.5 g / 0.3 mol implies 135.0 against 133.34, high by 1.2%, treated as rounding and not flagged. So no molar_mass_inconsistent is raised on this step. Product closure: limiting input 0.200 mol; product 2-chloro-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene as named and drawn is C8H9ClO2S, MW 204.67; theoretical 0.200 x 204.67 = 40.93 g; at the stated 84% that is 34.38 g; the printed mass is 28.6 g, which is only 69.9% of theory. DOES NOT CLOSE. The printed 28.6 g and 84% close only against MW 170.2, which is the des-chloro analogue 6-methanesulfonyltoluene C8H10O2S = 170.23, i.e. the chlorine is missing from the patent's own weight (Cl - H = 34.45). That same 170.2 is what step 2 charges for this compound, so the error is carried forward rather than isolated. Flag raised: mass_balance_implausible. Numbers recorded exactly as printed.
drawing_evidence: [IMAGE_EXTRACT: {"molecules": [...]}] at line 185, SMILES Cc1c(Cl)cccc1S(C)(=O)=O, formula C8H9ClO2S, InChIKey LZVOHXBKNVKJGZ-UHFFFAOYSA-N. This is a single-structure span, not a reaction scheme, and it depicts the product named in the heading 2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯. Drawing and prose agree, so no drawing_text_conflict. The drawn structure carries the ring chlorine, which is precisely the atom the printed mass/yield arithmetic omits, so the drawing is direct evidence that the arithmetic and not the structure is at fault.

quote_zh: 加入2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯34.0g(0.2mol)、无水三氯化铝40.5g(0.3mol)和二氯甲烷，在15-20℃温度条件下，滴加乙酰氯23.5g(0.3mol)，滴加完毕后，在室温继续反应5h，...，浓缩得白色固体2-氯-3-乙酰基-6-甲磺酰基甲苯36.5g，收率86％，熔点110-112℃。
arithmetic_check: Charges: substrate 34.0 g / 0.2 mol implies MW 170.0, but 2-chloro-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene is C8H9ClO2S = 204.67. Shortfall 34.67, which equals a chlorine-for-hydrogen substitution (Cl - H = 34.45), and 170.0 matches the des-chloro analogue C8H10O2S = 170.23 to within 0.2. Acetyl chloride 23.5 g / 0.3 mol implies 78.33 against C2H3ClO = 78.50, correct. Aluminium trichloride 135.0 against 133.34, rounding. Flag: molar_mass_inconsistent. Product closure: input 0.200 mol; product C10H11ClO3S, MW 246.71; theoretical 49.34 g; at the stated 86% that is 42.43 g; printed 36.5 g = 74.0% of theory. DOES NOT CLOSE. The printed pair closes against MW 212.2, again the des-chloro value C10H12O3S = 212.26, which is exactly what step 3 charges. Flag: mass_balance_implausible. Continuity: step 1 isolated 28.6 g of this substrate but this step charges 34.0 g, i.e. more material than the preceding step produced. Flag: scale_discontinuity. Numbers recorded exactly as printed.
drawing_evidence: [IMAGE_EXTRACT: {"molecules": [...]}] at line 195, SMILES CC(=O)c1ccc(S(C)(=O)=O)c(C)c1Cl, formula C10H11ClO3S, InChIKey KLJPFWVJHXRIPL-UHFFFAOYSA-N. Single structure, matches the heading name 2-氯-3-乙酰基-6-甲磺酰基甲苯 and confirms acylation para to the sulfone and ortho to the ring chlorine. Drawing and prose agree; no drawing_text_conflict. The drawn structure again carries the chlorine the arithmetic omits.

quote_zh: 加入2-氯-3-乙酰基-6-甲磺酰基甲苯50.88g(0.24mol)和200ml四氢呋喃溶液，在室温下滴加15％的次氯酸钠溶液500g，滴加完毕，升温回流5h，...，用乙醇重结晶，水洗，干燥得白色固体82g，收率72％，熔点230-233℃。
arithmetic_check: THIS IS THE STEP WHOSE MASS CANNOT BE RECONCILED WITH ITS OWN STATED YIELD ON ANY READING. Charges: substrate 50.88 g / 0.24 mol implies MW 212.0 against C10H11ClO3S = 246.71, the des-chloro value again (212.26). Flag: molar_mass_inconsistent. Oxidant: 500 g of 15% sodium hypochlorite is 75 g of NaOCl, MW 74.44, about 1.01 mol, roughly 4.2 equivalents against 0.24 mol, ample for a haloform reaction, so no flag on the oxidant. Product closure: input 0.240 mol; product C9H9ClO4S, MW 248.68; theoretical maximum at complete conversion 0.240 x 248.68 = 59.68 g; at the stated 72% that is 42.97 g; but 82 g is printed. 82 g is 137.4% of the theoretical maximum, so the printed mass exceeds what the printed input moles could give even at quantitative conversion. Taking mass and yield together implies MW 474.5, which corresponds to no species in this reaction. The figure does not close against the patent's own des-chloro weight either: 0.240 x 214.24 = 51.4 g theoretical, 37.0 g at 72%. To reach 82 g at 72% would require an input of about 0.458 mol, roughly double what is charged. DOES NOT CLOSE ON ANY READING. Flag: mass_balance_implausible. Continuity: step 2 isolated 36.5 g but this step charges 50.88 g, and the molar scale rises from 0.2 mol to 0.24 mol with no explanation. Flag: scale_discontinuity. Numbers recorded exactly as printed and not corrected.
drawing_evidence: [IMAGE_EXTRACT: {"molecules": [...]}] at line 204, SMILES Cc1c(S(C)(=O)=O)ccc(C(=O)O)c1Cl, formula C9H9ClO4S, InChIKey RRFGGUXLGOVPOP-UHFFFAOYSA-N. Single structure, matches the heading name 2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸 and confirms that the acetyl group has become a carboxylic acid, which is what identifies the transformation as a haloform oxidation. Drawing and prose agree; no drawing_text_conflict.

quote_zh: 在250ml的四口反应瓶中加入2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸42.8g(0.2mol)，对甲苯磺酸0.5g和200ml甲醇，加热回流搅拌10h，反应完毕，冷却，减压蒸出甲醇，冷却析出固体，用乙醇重结晶，得白色固体44.2g，收率97％，熔点105-107℃。
arithmetic_check: Charges: substrate 42.8 g / 0.2 mol implies MW 214.0 against C9H9ClO4S = 248.68. Shortfall 34.68, a chlorine-for-hydrogen substitution, matching the des-chloro acid C9H10O4S = 214.24 to within 0.24. Flag: molar_mass_inconsistent. p-Toluenesulfonic acid 0.5 g and methanol 200 ml carry no mole figures, so nothing to check. Product closure: input 0.200 mol; product C10H11ClO4S, MW 262.71; theoretical 52.54 g; at the stated 97% that is 50.97 g; printed 44.2 g = 84.1% of theory. DOES NOT CLOSE. The printed pair closes against MW 227.8, which is near but not equal to the des-chloro methyl ester C10H12O4S = 228.26, and which also disagrees with the 218.0 that step 5 charges for this same compound, so the patent is not internally consistent across the handover either. Flag: mass_balance_implausible. Continuity: this step charges 42.8 g out of the 82 g step 3 reports isolating, a subset and therefore possible, so scale_discontinuity is NOT raised. Numbers recorded exactly as printed.
drawing_evidence: [IMAGE_EXTRACT: {"molecules": [...]}] at line 213, SMILES COC(=O)c1ccc(S(C)(=O)=O)c(C)c1Cl, formula C10H11ClO4S, InChIKey BBWCBPYXCNCYAT-UHFFFAOYSA-N. Single structure, matches the heading name 2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯 and confirms methyl esterification with the ring methyl untouched, which is what separates this step from the bromination that follows. Drawing and prose agree; no drawing_text_conflict.

quote_zh: 加入2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯43.6g(0.2mol)和500ml四氯化碳，再加入0.5g过氧苯甲酸，在室温下滴加39.6g(0.22mol)溴素，滴加时间约50min，滴加完毕，升温回流6h。...，干燥得固体41.6g，收率70％，熔点75-78℃。
arithmetic_check: Two independent mass/mole defects in this step. Charges: substrate 43.6 g / 0.2 mol implies MW 218.0 against C10H11ClO4S = 262.71, a shortfall of 44.71, which is larger than a chlorine-for-hydrogen substitution and does not match the des-chloro methyl ester (228.26) either, so the pattern is not a clean des-chloro here. Bromine 39.6 g / 0.22 mol implies MW 180.0 against Br2 = 159.81, an over-statement of 12.6%; 39.6 g of bromine is actually 0.248 mol. Flag: molar_mass_inconsistent, on both pairs. Product closure: input 0.200 mol; product C10H10BrClO4S, MW 341.60; theoretical 68.32 g; at the stated 70% that is 47.82 g; printed 41.6 g = 60.9% of theory. DOES NOT CLOSE. The printed pair closes against MW 297.1, which also disagrees with the 279.0 that step 6 charges for this compound. Flag: mass_balance_implausible. Continuity: 43.6 g charged against the 44.2 g step 4 reports isolating is a subset and therefore possible, so scale_discontinuity is NOT raised. Note that the 50 min is a dropwise addition time, not a reaction time, and is recorded in the bromine addition_profile rather than in time_h, which carries the 6 h reflux. Numbers recorded exactly as printed.
drawing_evidence: [IMAGE_EXTRACT: {"molecules": [...]}] at line 225, SMILES COC(=O)c1ccc(S(C)(=O)=O)c(CBr)c1Cl, formula C10H10BrClO4S, InChIKey YQYVOGFWLVVXMM-UHFFFAOYSA-N. Single structure, matches the heading name 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯. It shows monobromination on the side-chain methyl rather than on the ring, which corroborates the radical benzylic reading of the peroxide-initiated bromine reaction; the prose does not state the position, so the drawing is the evidence for it. Drawing and prose agree; no drawing_text_conflict.

quote_zh: 加入2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯55.8g(0.2mol)，三氟乙醇钠28.1g(0.23mol)和100mlTHF溶剂中，室温搅拌16h，然后水洗，浓缩得2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸乙酯，加入氢氧化钠9.2g(0.23mol)和水10ml，回流反应4h。...，浓缩得55.6g白色固体，收率92％，熔点154-157℃。
arithmetic_check: One-pot step, two transformations, one isolated product, so the closure test is run on the overall step. Charges: substrate 55.8 g / 0.2 mol implies MW 279.0 against C10H10BrClO4S = 341.60, a shortfall of 62.6. Sodium 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxide 28.1 g / 0.23 mol implies 122.17 against C2H2F3NaO = 122.02, correct. Sodium hydroxide 9.2 g / 0.23 mol implies 40.0 against 40.00, exactly correct. So the two reagent pairs are right and only the aromatic substrate pair is wrong. Flag: molar_mass_inconsistent. Product closure: input 0.200 mol; product C11H10ClF3O5S, MW 346.70; theoretical 69.34 g; at the stated 92% that is 63.79 g; printed 55.6 g = 80.2% of theory. DOES NOT CLOSE against the drawn structure. The printed pair closes against MW 302.2, and step 7 charges this same compound at 60.4 g / 0.2 mol = 302.0, so the patent is internally self-consistent at 302 while being 44.7 short of the true 346.70 at both points. Flag: mass_balance_implausible. Continuity: step 5 isolated 41.6 g but this step charges 55.8 g, more material than the preceding step produced. Flag: scale_discontinuity. Numbers recorded exactly as printed.
drawing_evidence: [IMAGE_EXTRACT: {"molecules": [...]}] at line 234, SMILES CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)O)c(Cl)c1COCC(F)(F)F, formula C11H10ClF3O5S, InChIKey YGMJOCQCLVNPOD-UHFFFAOYSA-N. Single structure, matches the heading name and, importantly, is drawn as the free carboxylic ACID, which corroborates the prose that the ester formed in the first transformation is hydrolysed in the second and confirms the one-pot reading. It also silently contradicts the prose's naming of the unisolated intermediate as the ETHYL ester (乙酯) when a methyl ester was charged, but no structure is drawn for that intermediate, so this is recorded as an internal naming inconsistency in notes rather than as drawing_text_conflict. Drawing and prose otherwise agree.

quote_zh: 加入2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸60.4g(0.2mol)，N,N-二甲基甲酰胺(0.05g)和100ml二氯甲烷，在室温下，滴加氯化亚砜71.4(0.6mol)，升温回流搅拌6h。蒸除溶剂，残余物加入二氯甲烷100ml，冷却至5℃，滴加入环己二酮24.5g(0.22mol)和三乙胺22.2g(0.22mol)的混合物，滴毕，升至室温搅拌8h。...，浓缩得油状物72.8g，收率92％。
arithmetic_check: One-pot step, two transformations, one isolated product. Charges: substrate 60.4 g / 0.2 mol implies MW 302.0 against C11H10ClF3O5S = 346.70, a shortfall of 44.70, identical to the 302.2 implied by step 6's own product figures, so the same wrong weight is used at both ends of the handover. Thionyl chloride 71.4 / 0.6 mol implies 119.0 against SOCl2 = 118.97, correct, although the Chinese omits the mass unit. Cyclohexane-1,3-dione 24.5 g / 0.22 mol implies 111.36 against C6H8O2 = 112.13, correct within 0.7%. Triethylamine 22.2 g / 0.22 mol implies 100.91 against C6H15N = 101.19, correct. Only the aromatic substrate pair is wrong. Flag: molar_mass_inconsistent. Product closure: input 0.200 mol; product C17H16ClF3O6S, MW 440.82; theoretical 88.16 g; at the stated 92% that is 81.11 g; printed 72.8 g = 82.6% of theory. DOES NOT CLOSE. The printed pair closes against MW 395.7, and step 8 charges this same compound at 198 g / 0.5 mol = 396.0, so again the patent is internally consistent at 396 while being about 45 short of the true 440.82. Flag: mass_balance_implausible. Continuity: step 6 isolated 55.6 g but this step charges 60.4 g, more than the preceding step produced. Flag: scale_discontinuity. Numbers recorded exactly as printed.
drawing_evidence: [IMAGE_EXTRACT: {"molecules": [...]}] at line 241, SMILES CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)OC2=CC(=O)CCC2)c(Cl)c1COCC(F)(F)F, formula C17H16ClF3O6S, InChIKey OBAMHTWSCBVWGB-UHFFFAOYSA-N. Single structure, matches the heading name 3-氧代-1-环己烯酯. It is drawn as the O-acyl enol ester with the ester oxygen on the cyclohexenone ring, which is the evidence that the final transformation of this step is an esterification and not yet the C-acylation, and it is what makes step 8 identifiable as a rearrangement. The drawing also resolves the prose's unlocanted 环己二酮 to the 1,3-dione. Drawing and prose agree; no drawing_text_conflict.

quote_zh: 在装有干燥管的反应瓶中加入2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯198g(0.5mol)，0.2g氰基丙酮和三乙胺60.6(0.6mol)溶于500ml乙腈溶剂中，反应物在室温持续搅拌24h。...，浓缩得米黄色固体188g，收率95％，熔点120-123℃。
arithmetic_check: Charges: substrate 198 g / 0.5 mol implies MW 396.0 against C17H16ClF3O6S = 440.82, a shortfall of 44.82, the same wrong weight step 7 used for its product. Triethylamine 60.6 / 0.6 mol implies 101.0 against C6H15N = 101.19, correct, although the Chinese omits the mass unit. Cyanoacetone 0.2 g carries no mole figure. Flag: molar_mass_inconsistent. Product closure: this is an isomerisation, so product and substrate share the formula C17H16ClF3O6S, MW 440.82; input 0.500 mol gives theoretical 220.41 g; at the stated 95% that is 209.39 g; printed 188 g = 85.3% of theory. DOES NOT CLOSE against the drawn structures. The printed pair closes against MW 395.8, matching this step's own substrate figure of 396.0, which is self-consistent for an isomerisation and confirms that the defect is the molecular weight the patent is using and not the yield arithmetic. Flag: mass_balance_implausible. Continuity, the most extreme in the section: step 7 isolated 72.8 g / 0.2 mol but this step charges 198 g / 0.5 mol, nearly a factor of three more material than the preceding step produced. Flag: scale_discontinuity. Numbers recorded exactly as printed and not corrected. SECTION SUMMARY OF THE ARITHMETIC: all eight steps fail the mass-versus-yield closure test against the compounds as named and drawn; seven of the eight (steps 2 through 8) additionally print a substrate mass/mole pair implying a molecular weight below the true one, in steps 2, 3 and 4 by exactly a chlorine-for-hydrogen substitution; step 1's own charges are the only fully correct set; and step 3 is the single step whose printed mass exceeds its own theoretical maximum and cannot be reconciled with its yield on any molecular weight.
drawing_evidence: [IMAGE_EXTRACT: {"molecules": [...]}] at line 251, SMILES CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)C2C(=O)CCCC2=O)c(Cl)c1COCC(F)(F)F, formula C17H16ClF3O6S, InChIKey IUQAXCIUEPFPSF-UHFFFAOYSA-N. Single structure, and the decisive evidence for this step: it is the C-acylated cyclohexane-1,3-dione, an isomer of the O-acyl enol ester drawn at line 241 with the identical formula, which identifies the transformation as an O-to-C acyl migration and corroborates the identification of 环磺草酮 as tembotrione. Drawing and prose agree. SEPARATE, OUTSIDE THIS SECTION: the multi-arrow reaction scheme at line 174 sits before the 具体实施方式 heading and therefore belongs to the preceding section, not to Example 1. Its arrow 9 draws acetone cyanohydrin, described in the vision extract as a quaternary carbon bearing CN with an OH and two methyls, whereas this step's prose charges cyanoacetone (氰基丙酮). Per the rule that a scheme-versus-prose conflict is raised on the scheme's own records in the section that contains it, drawing_text_conflict is NOT raised here and the prose is kept as written. Recorded so the conflict is not lost, and left for the annotation of that section to resolve.
